required_review: Russian fluency and absence of unintended mode ambiguity in all 48 rendered forms
Executed and Forced alone advance implicit clock; explicit timestamps permit narration reordering
Denied means a newly proposed command was not executed, not retroactive cancellation
Unknown means no new measurement and never a zero-valued observation
Names bind by the two initial C observations at time0: first introduced device-0, second device-1; consistent within record, not across records; no sidecar or speaker change.
Approval must name the exact catalog SHA256; changed catalog requires new review
binding_semantics: First two messages introduce distinct devices through C observations at time0: first introduced name binds to device-0, second to device-1. Names have no permanent ID across histories. Initial introductions persist across challenge transforms; model receives no names-to-ID sidecar.
